purpose: Qualify the TP2 Q4_K WDC mechanism for correctness, determinism, cache isolation, and realistic HTTP service before promotion.

required: 12/12 output text SHA-256 values exactly equal the promoted target-only Q4_K oracle
all token-ID digests exactly equal the pinned sequential oracle
candidate engagement warning present and control warning absent

determinism_rule: The candidate concurrency profile must pass the complete 64-response token-ID oracle on two independent fresh servers.
system_rules: one model server at a time
fresh server for every listed run
no GPU reset, fault, device-lost, OOM, or model-process segfault evidence
no prompt cache or reused response
do not use oneDNN verbose or debugger instrumentation in measured runs
publication_policy: The prior batched-bench speed is not a headline. Only output-qualified HTTP results may be promoted, and the realistic diverse-prompt rate remains the single-user headline metric.
